inputs.text: [chuckles] In 1868, a scientist put his skeleton together for the very first time. [amazed] And he got it wrong — he glued the head onto the TAIL, [playful] thinking it was the neck.
[gasps] He put the head on backward?
[softly] Backward, yes. Another scientist pointed out the mistake — [chuckles] the biggest blunder in the history of dinosaurs.
